project: blind independent rerun of DESI DR2 BAO cosmology

paper.title: DESI DR2 Results II: Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and Cosmological Constraints
paper.authors: DESI Collaboration (M. Abdul Karim et al.)

claims.quantity: Omega_m, flat LCDM, DESI DR2 BAO alone
claims.stated_where: eq. (17), Section VI (COSMOLOGICAL CONSTRAINTS IN THE LCDM MODEL), labelled DESI DR2; repeated in Table III row DESI and in the Conclusions
claims.data: desi_bao_dr2/desi_gaussian_bao_ALL_GCcomb_mean.txt + _cov.txt (13 entries, 7 tracers: BGS z=0.295 DV/rd; LRG1 0.510, LRG2 0.706, LRG3+ELG1 0.934, ELG2 1.321, QSO 1.484, Lya 2.330 each DM/rd and DH/rd)
claims.priors: flat on Omega_m and on h*rd; no BBN, no theta_star, no CMB, no SNe

claims.quantity: h*rd in Mpc (h = H0/100), flat LCDM, DESI DR2 BAO alone
claims.stated_where: eq. (17), Section VI, same fit as C1 (paper writes it as h rd, correlation with Omega_m r = -0.92)

claims.quantity: H0 in km/s/Mpc, flat LCDM, DESI DR2 BAO + BBN prior on omega_b
claims.stated_where: unnumbered display equation in Section VI following eq. (18), labelled (DESI+BBN); same value in Table III row DESI+BBN
claims.which_h0_and_why: The paper quotes two H0 values from BAO plus BBN: 68.51 +/- 0.58 (DESI+BBN) and 68.45 +/- 0.47 (DESI+BBN+theta_star). The target 68.51 +/- 0.58 is the DESI+BBN one, i.e. BAO plus the BBN omega_b prior ONLY. The second adds a Gaussian prior 100*theta_star = 1.04110 +/- 0.00053 (eq. 16), which is CMB information, so it is not BAO+BBN alone. Also matched by the quoted sigma (0.58 vs 0.47).
claims.data: same 13-entry DESI DR2 vector as C1
claims.priors: flat on Omega_m and H0; Gaussian omega_b = Omega_b h^2 = 0.02218 +/- 0.00055 (eq. 14 of the paper, PRyMordial-based, standard LCDM)

fixed_physics.neutrino_hierarchy: single non-zero mass eigenstate (paper Section V)
fixed_physics.r_d: sound horizon at the drag epoch from CAMB get_derived_params()[rdrag]

route.summary: Own Gaussian likelihood on the 13 published distance ratios with the published covariance; background distances and r_drag from CAMB 1.5.4; brute-force grid marginalisation instead of MCMC (emcee is not installed in the reused venv).
route.key_identity: Every entry of the data vector scales as 1/(h*rd): DM/rd = (h*DM)/(h*rd) etc., and (h*DM) is h-independent up to the radiation term in E(z). So for a given Omega_m the model is A(Omega_m)/x with x = h*rd, and chi2(Omega_m, x) = a0 - 2*a1/x + a2/x^2 with a0 = d^T C^-1 d, a1 = A^T C^-1 d, a2 = A^T C^-1 A. This is exact, no interpolation in x.
route.C1_C2: 2D grid in (Omega_m, x = h*rd), flat priors, marginalise numerically; report mean and standard deviation of each 1D marginal.
route.C3: 3D grid in (Omega_m, H0, omega_b). r_d from a CAMB lookup table in (omega_b, omega_m = Omega_m*h^2) since r_d depends only on those two in this model; x = h*rd is then derived and chi2 comes from the same exact formula. Flat priors on Omega_m and H0, Gaussian prior on omega_b. Report mean and standard deviation of the 1D H0 marginal.
route.radiation_h_dependence: h*DM(z) depends on h only through Omega_r = omega_r/h^2. Computed at h_ref = 0.68 and the size of the residual h-dependence is measured over h in [0.64, 0.72] and logged as a check.

grids.camb_rd_table: omega_b on linspace(0.0180, 0.0264, 29), omega_m on linspace(0.0900, 0.2100, 41), bicubic spline in log-log; accuracy checked against direct CAMB calls at random points

tolerance.rule: PASS for a claim requires BOTH: |my_mean - published_mean| <= 0.20 * published_sigma, AND |my_sigma - published_sigma| <= 0.10 * published_sigma.
tolerance.justification: This is the tolerance this project has used on earlier reruns, so results stay comparable across papers. 0.20 sigma on the mean is tight enough that a wrong data vector, a wrong prior or a missing dataset shows up, but loose enough to absorb MCMC noise in the published value (the paper only converges to R-1 < 0.01) and the small differences between my grid marginalisation and their Metropolis-Hastings chains. 10% on sigma catches a wrong covariance or a wrong parameter count while tolerating the same chain noise.
tolerance.verdict_rule: Reproduced = all three claims pass. Partially reproduced = one or two pass. Not reproduced = none pass.

guard_checks_planned: data vector compared entry by entry with Table IV of the paper (DV/rd, DM/rd, DH/rd per tracer) and sigmas compared with sqrt of the covariance diagonal
covariance symmetry (max |C - C^T|) and positive definiteness (Cholesky, min eigenvalue)
my chi2 at a fixed cosmology compared against cobaya 3.5 own released DESI DR2 BAO likelihood at the same cosmology
grid edge mass: the posterior mass in the first and last bin of every 1D marginal must be below 1e-6, otherwise the result is declared invalid
residual h-dependence of h*DM(z) across h in [0.64, 0.72] measured and reported
r_d interpolation table error against direct CAMB calls

environment.emcee: NOT installed, hence the grid route

not_tested: the BAO fitting itself (we start from the published compressed distance ratios, not from DESI catalogues)
any extended model (curvature, w0waCDM, neutrino mass)
any combination with CMB, SNe or theta_star
the published correlation coefficient r = -0.92 is reported but not part of the pass/fail rule
